changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Define attachment filter categories and selectors in constants file.

logic: Create and export a new object constant 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG'.
Populate 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG' with keys for IMAGE, PDF, DOCUMENT, SPREADSHEET, and PRESENTATION.
Each key's value must be an object containing 'extensions' (array of strings), 'icon' (string), and 'labelKey' (string).
Add 'attachmentRow: 'div.brd'' to the existing 'SELECTORS' object.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the file is imported, when 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG.IMAGE.icon' is accessed, then it must return 'image'.
Given the file is imported, when 'SELECTORS.attachmentRow' is accessed, then it must return 'div.brd'.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Add internationalisation keys for new filter buttons.

logic: Add JSON keys 'button_filter_images', 'button_filter_pdfs', 'button_filter_documents', 'button_filter_spreadsheets', 'button_filter_presentations'.
Each key's value must be an object with a 'message' key and the corresponding English text (e.g., 'Images Only').
acceptanceCriteria: Given the JSON is parsed, when the value for key 'button_filter_images' is accessed, then it must be an object '{ "message": "Images Only" }'.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Update state management to include new filter modes.

logic: Append the strings 'IMAGE', 'PDF', 'DOCUMENT', 'SPREADSHEET', 'PRESENTATION' to the 'FILTER_MODES' array.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the file is imported, when 'FILTER_MODES.includes("IMAGE")' is checked, then it must return true.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Implement the core logic for identifying specific attachment types in an email row.

inputs.name: row
inputs.description: The DOM element for the email row.

outputs.description: True if a matching attachment is found, otherwise false.

logic: Query the row for all attachment chips using the 'SELECTORS.attachmentChip' selector.
Get the list of valid extensions from 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[attachmentType].extensions'.
Iterate through each chip.
Extract filename from the chip's 'title' attribute or the 'textContent' of its title span.
Extract the file extension and normalize to lowercase.
Check if the extension is in the list of valid extensions.
Also check the chip's 'data-tooltip' attribute for Google Drive file identifiers.
If a match is found, return true immediately.
If the loop finishes, return false.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a row with an attachment titled 'report.pdf', when called with attachmentType 'PDF', then it must return true.
Given a row with an attachment titled 'image.jpg', when called with attachmentType 'PDF', then it must return false.
Given a row with a Google Doc attachment, when called with attachmentType 'DOCUMENT', then it must return true.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Update the main applyFilter function to use the new specific attachment logic.

outputs.description: Applies the filter to the DOM.

logic: In the main loop that iterates through email rows, add cases for the new filter modes ('IMAGE', 'PDF', etc.).
For these cases, the condition to show a row is 'hasAttachmentRow(row) && hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, mode)'.
Set the row's 'style.display' based on the outcome of this condition.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the mode is 'PDF', when applyFilter is run, then only rows with PDF attachments must be visible.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Dynamically generate new filter buttons in the toolbar.

logic: Import 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG' from constants.
Iterate over the keys of 'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_CONFIG'.
For each key, create a new button element.
Set the button's id, icon, title, and aria-label based on the configuration for that key.
Append the new buttons to the toolbar DOM element in the correct order.
acceptanceCriteria: Given createToolbar is called, when the DOM is inspected, then a button with id 'filter-IMAGE' must exist.
Given createToolbar is called, when the DOM is inspected, then the button with id 'filter-PDF' must have the title 'PDFs Only'.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Add unit tests for the hasSpecificAttachmentType function.

acceptanceCriteria: Given a mock row with a '.jpg' attachment, when hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, 'IMAGE') is called, then it must return true.
Given a mock row with a '.docx' attachment, when hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, 'DOCUMENT') is called, then it must return true.
Given a mock row with a '.gsheet' attachment, when hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, 'SPREADSHEET') is called, then it must return true.
Given a mock row with a '.zip' attachment, when hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, 'IMAGE') is called, then it must return false.
Given a mock row with multiple attachments including a '.pdf', when hasSpecificAttachmentType(row, 'PDF') is called, then it must return true.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Add unit tests for the updated toolbar creation logic.

logic: Mock 'chrome.i18n.getMessage' to return predictable labels.
Call 'createToolbar' on a mock DOM element.
Assert that five new buttons have been added.
Assert that a button with id 'filter-SPREADSHEET' exists and has the correct icon and mocked label.
acceptanceCriteria: Given createToolbar is executed, when the number of child buttons is counted, then it must equal the original number plus five.
